title: Input Position in the Initial Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word. Define the extended input lookup $\widehat{x}(z)$ for $z\in\mathbb{Z}$ to be the $(z-1)$-st entry of $x$ when $z\geq1$ and that index is in range, and absent otherwise. In the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$, the input symbol seen at offset $d\in\mathbb{Z}$ is $\widehat{x}(1+d)$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols
